description: Witness offsets use zero-based half-open source UTF-8 bytes; inner numeric selectors use Unicode characters within quote. Exact bytes verify custody, not experimental meaning. Select the complete supported source definition, including all alternative endpoint branches. The finite reader supports the opening 'one unit was defined as' or 'one unit was equivalent to' (case-insensitive), optionally followed by 'the oxidation of', 'oxidation of', 'the reduction of', 'reduction of', 'the formation of' or 'formation of'. Each branch has a positive literal amount, pmol/nmol/umol (including micro-symbol spellings), an optional 'of', the entity, an optional oxidized/reduced/formed, and 'per' min/minute/s/second. Branches are separated by a comma, 'or', or comma followed by 'or'. Preserve actual source wording; unsupported wording is a reader limitation and must never be rewritten to fit.
